notes: Built automatically, not checked by a person. The species are the most often recorded in GBIF within about 5.99400000000007 km of the park location (location from PAD-US boundary). Feeding links are only those with a GloBI record: for the species itself, its genus or, for plants and insects, its family. Library: automatic.
